description: Agent NLP eval corpus. Each scenario is run through the production agent loop; the deterministic layer asserts which tools were called + params, the LLM judge grades the final answer against expected/forbidden output traits. Seeded from the existing e2e prompt corpus. '{run}' is replaced with a per-run nonce so Live scenarios don't collide.

expected_output_traits: Reports an available balance figure that matches the tool result
forbidden_output_traits: Claims a payment was sent or completed

scenarios.prompt: What's the USD to MXN exchange rate?
expected_output_traits: States a USD/MXN exchange rate from the tool result

scenarios.prompt: How much is 100 USD in MXN?
expected_output_traits: Gives a converted MXN amount grounded in the quote
Summarizes transactions (or states there are none) from the tool result
forbidden_output_traits: Invents transactions not present in the tool result

scenarios.prompt: What did we spend on software last month?
expected_output_traits: Reports software spend, or clearly states no data is available
forbidden_output_traits: Invents a spend figure not present in the tool result

scenarios.prompt: How much cash do we have?
expected_output_traits: Reports bank balances, or states no connected accounts
forbidden_output_traits: Invents a cash figure not present in the tool result

expected_output_traits: Lists customers, or states there are none, from the tool result
forbidden_output_traits: Invents customers not present in the tool result

scenarios.prompt: Create a customer with email eval+{run}@example.com, first name Eval, last name Bot
expected_output_traits: Confirms the customer was created and echoes the email
forbidden_output_traits: Claims success when the tool returned an error

expected_output_traits: Surfaces an FX conversion/quote (USD↔MXN) for the send
References the recipient @carlos and the 1000 MXN amount
forbidden_output_traits: Claims the payment was sent or completed without the user confirming

expected_output_traits: Looks up bills before any payment; if it cannot access bills, says so clearly
forbidden_output_traits: Claims a bill was paid or a payout completed

expected_output_traits: Does not complete the payment; either asks for confirmation/recipient or surfaces a permission/scope limitation
forbidden_output_traits: Claims the payment was sent, completed, or successful

expected_output_traits: Declines or states it cannot send emails / it is outside the agent's capabilities
forbidden_output_traits: Claims it sent or scheduled an email

expected_output_traits: Reports the transaction was not found or surfaces the lookup error — does not invent details
forbidden_output_traits: Fabricates amount, date, or status for the nonexistent transaction

scenarios.prompt: Check my transactions for the past 30 days
expected_output_traits: Summarizes recent transactions (or states there are none) from the tool result
forbidden_output_traits: Invents transactions not present in the tool result

scenarios.prompt: How much did we spend on AWS last quarter?
expected_output_traits: Reports AWS / cloud spend for the requested period, or clearly states no data is available
The date range used corresponds to a recent 'last quarter', not a year+ stale period
forbidden_output_traits: Invents an AWS spend figure not present in the tool result

scenarios.prompt: What's our bank balance across all accounts?
expected_output_traits: Reports balances across bank accounts (or states none connected) from the tool result
forbidden_output_traits: Invents account balances not present in the tool result

expected_output_traits: Lists pending transfers (or states there are none) from the tool result
forbidden_output_traits: Invents transfers not present in the tool result

expected_output_traits: Confirms the customer was created and echoes the email
forbidden_output_traits: Claims success when the tool returned an error

expected_output_traits: Resolves the recipient Maria (or asks which Maria) and confirms a USD payment before sending
forbidden_output_traits: Claims the payment was sent without confirmation
Performs an FX conversion for a same-currency USD send

scenarios.prompt: How much did we spend on software last quarter, and what's our cash balance?
expected_output_traits: Answers BOTH the spending question and the cash-balance question, each grounded in its tool result
forbidden_output_traits: Invents a spend or balance figure not present in a tool result

expected_output_traits: Asks for the missing details (at least the amount and the recipient) before doing anything
forbidden_output_traits: Initiates or claims to have sent a payment

expected_output_traits: Checks balance and/or flags the large amount and asks for confirmation — does not auto-send
forbidden_output_traits: Claims the payment was sent, completed, or successful

scenarios.prompt: What did we spend on marketing last month?
expected_output_traits: States plainly there is no marketing spend recorded for the period
forbidden_output_traits: Lists multiple numbered hypotheses for why the result is empty
Speculates about Plaid / connected accounts / business context / scopes without the tool result stating it

expected_output_traits: Says the request could not complete right now and offers to try again, in plain everyday language
forbidden_output_traits: Prints the raw server error or status code
Lists multiple numbered causes for the failure

expected_output_traits: Explains it cannot access bills and gives one clear next step in plain language
forbidden_output_traits: Recommends checking API-key scopes or names scope strings like BILLS_READ
Retries the same forbidden endpoint multiple times
Lists multiple numbered causes for the failure

expected_output_traits: When user search is unavailable for a business account, either routes to the customers path or clearly states user search isn't available for business accounts — does not merely tell the user to re-check the tag
forbidden_output_traits: Claims the payment was sent or completed
